ctx.title: Inji Vellam: Vijay Sethupathi and Sai Pallavi starrer to be a school love turned realistic adult romance? Find out
ctx.summary:
Inji Vellam, starring Vijay Sethupathi and Sai Pallavi in the lead roles, is slated for a theatrical release on January 29, 2027. Directed by Mani Ratnam, the film is reportedly a coming-of-age romantic drama inspired by real-life events, potentially making it one of the most grounded films in the director's career. 
 Inji Vellam: Vijay Sethupathi and Sai Pallavi blend school love with realistic adult romance? 
 According to a report by Valai Pechu,  Inji Vellam  revolves around twins. Vijay Sethupathi and Sai Pallavi's characters are said to fall in love during their Plus Two years and eventually get married, with the couple's children being twins. 
 The film is also reportedly inspired by a real-life story and is expected to adopt a realistic approach, with minimal creative exaggeration or fantasy. Incidents from the life of Mani Ratnam's brother, Sreenivasan, are also said to have served as inspiration. 
 Co-produced by Lyca Productions, Madras Talkies and India Talkies, the romantic drama is written and directed by Mani Ratnam. The film also features Chaitra J Achar in a key role, with AR Rahman composing the music and background score. The makers recently unveiled a track titled Aachi Aachi.
